rationale: C17 is a direct drafting template: it invokes the identical statutory definition, recites the same Treasury finding after notice and hearing, and uses virtually the same operative proclamation declaring a drug to have addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine with immediate effect. The child adapts this machinery from one drug to seven. C20 is another very close instance of the same template but is slightly weaker because C17 concerns the closely related drug Keto-bemidone and more nearly matches the child's wording. C08 shares a statutory-finding proclamation structure but not the distinctive opiate language or precise machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas section 3228(f) of the Internal Revenue Code provides in part as follow: Opiate. The word "opiate" ... shall mean any drug ... found by the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, to have an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine or cocaine, and proclaimed by the President to have been so found by the Secretary.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas section 3228(f) of the Internal Revenue Code provides in part as follows: (f) OPIATE. The word "opiate" ... shall mean any drug ... found by the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, to have an addition-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine or cocaine, and proclaimed by the President to have been so found by the Secretary.
shared_material.explanation: The child reproduces the same statutory passage and the same legal mechanism almost verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: And Whereas the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, has found that each of the following named drugs and their salts has addition-forming or addition-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately
shared_material.parent_excerpt: And Whereas the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, has found the drug Keto-bemidone ... to have an addition-forming and addition-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately
shared_material.explanation: The same predicate recital is converted from a finding about one named drug to findings about seven drugs and their salts.

shared_material.child_excerpt: do hereby proclaim that the Secretary of the Treasury has found that each of the aforementioned drugs and their salts has an addition-forming and addition-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: do hereby proclaim that the Secretary of the Treasury has found the drug Keto-bemidone ... to have an addition-forming and addition-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that ... the public interest this finding should be effective immediately.
shared_material.explanation: The operative provision follows the parent's distinctive wording and sequence, changing only the identified regulated substances from one drug to a list.
